title: LearningRecordDelivery
description: Outbox receipt for an immutable learning statement sent to an approved record store.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

institution_id.description: Institution owning these data and their access policy.
institution_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

profile_id.description: Approved xAPI or cmi5 output profile.
profile_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

statement_id.description: Stable xAPI statement ID allocated once.

destination_key.description: Approved learning record store route key.

payload_digest.description: Digest of canonical outbound statement bytes.

state.description: Authoritative lifecycle state advanced only through owner commands.

revision.description: Monotonic aggregate revision used for compare-and-swap.

x-invariants: Replays must use the same statement ID and content digest.
LRS delivery never substitutes for native grade or completion authority.
